thesis: The episode discusses the founders of Devoted Health, Ed and Todd Park, who aim to rewrite the rules of the U.S. healthcare system by building a new system from scratch to address issues of access, quality, and payment. The speakers describe the U.S. healthcare system as fundamentally broken and note that despite technological innovation in critical areas like public safety and care, these sectors are often misunderstood.
